premise: At 56 I poured my $95,000 widow’s inheritance into a charter‑fishing business with my brother, signing for 45% equity and naming the boat after our late mother, but he forged a bill of sale, pocketed a $400,000 deal for the boat and license, and offered me $8,000; I found the original agreement tucked in our mother’s sewing kit, voided the sale through court, and now run ‘Reel Betrayal Charters’ — my brother must bait every hook and scrub the deck in a hat reading ‘Hook, Line, and Sinker,’ while each fishing license prints the fraud docket number.
